findings.body: When a coordinator launches `forge work <item>` from the main checkout, this comparison cannot find its queued worker. `worker.py:58–59` resolves the item's worktree and `worker.py:97` passes that checkout to admission, while `cwd` here remains the coordinator's session directory. New evidence beyond the checkout-identity ruling is the real command test: `tests/test_machine_tab_lanes.py:96` launches from the main checkout, but line 116 asserts that `checkout_root` is the separate item worktree. Consequently the normal coordinator spinner shows no queue position. The native spinner test hides this mismatch by assigning both directories `/repo`. Associate the session's invoked run with its lane entry and test this real directory arrangement.
findings.title: Not done: this session's spinner queue place

findings.body: The proof list claims complete Desktop alt text, per-run tooltips and the tool/lane legend, but these tests do not protect those required behaviors. Replacing every tooltip with `<title>Run</title>` still satisfies line 70 while losing model, round and elapsed. Omitting the final queued test run from SVG alt text still satisfies the subset checked at line 67. Removing the legend entirely also passes every native assertion. Similarly, line 55 checks selector order rather than tree/list row order. Strengthen the existing mounted tests to verify every run's accessible facts, tooltip facts, displayed queue order and colour/symbol legend; these are explicit Done-when details rather than additional edge cases.
findings.title: Not done: Machine rendering tests cover the claimed facts

findings.body: The previously reported automation gap remains open. `forge.toml:6` and `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58` run Python tests; `tests/test_mod_plugin.py:45–57` typechecks the hooks without executing their native interaction tests. The reported manual run verifies this revision, but automated checks still cannot detect regressions in Machine selection, confirmation, output or surface rendering. `plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284` assigns the plugin test job to SHIP, so that task should wire these cases into the suite.
